```yaml
name: Docs Workflow

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install -g vuepress@next

    - name: Create docs directory
      run: mkdir docs

    - name: Initialize VuePress
      run: npx vuepress@next init docs

    - name: Configure VuePress
      run: echo "module.exports = { title: 'BookWorm Architecture', description: 'Living documentation for BookWorm' };" > docs/.vuepress/config.js

    - name: Create arc42 structure
      run: |
        mkdir -p docs/architecture
        touch docs/architecture/{01-introduction-and-goals,02-constraints,03-context-and-scope,04-solution-strategy,05-building-block-view,06-runtime-view,07-deployment-view,08-cross-cutting-concepts,09-architecture-decisions,10-quality-requirements,11-risks-and-technical-debt,12-glossary}.md

    - name: Add navigation and sidebar
      run: |
        echo "nav:\n  - text: Introduction\n    link: /architecture/01-introduction-and-goals\n  - text: Constraints\n    link: /architecture/02-constraints\n  - text: Context and Scope\n    link: /architecture/03-context-and-scope\n  - text: Solution Strategy\n    link: /architecture/04-solution-strategy\n  - text: Building Block View\n    link: /architecture/05-building-block-view\n  - text: Runtime View\n    link: /architecture/06-runtime-view\n  - text: Deployment View\n    link: /architecture/07-deployment-view\n  - text: Cross-cutting Concepts\n    link: /architecture/08-cross-cutting-concepts\n  - text: Architecture Decisions\n    link: /architecture/09-architecture-decisions\n  - text: Quality Requirements\n    link: /architecture/10-quality-requirements\n  - text: Risks and Technical Debt\n    link: /architecture/11-risks-and-technical-debt\n  - text: Glossary\n    link: /architecture/12-glossary" > docs/.vuepress/nav.js
        echo "sidebar:\n  '/architecture':\n    - Introduction\n    - Constraints\n    - Context and Scope\n    - Solution Strategy\n    - Building Block View\n    - Runtime View\n    - Deployment View\n    - Cross-cutting Concepts\n    - Architecture Decisions\n    - Quality Requirements\n    - Risks and Technical Debt\n    - Glossary" > docs/.vuepress/sidebar.js

    - name: Add scripts for local dev and build
      run: |
        echo "scripts:\n  docs:dev: vuepress dev docs\n  docs:build: vuepress build docs" >> package.json

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git add docs package.json .vuepress
        git commit -m "Setup architecture documentation using arc42 and VuePress"

    - name: Push changes
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./docs/.vuepress/dist
```
